about.title: About VitaLink
about.question1: What areas does VitaLink Courier LLC serve?
about.answer1: We serve the Greater Tampa Bay region including Pinellas County, Hillsborough County, and Pasco County as our primary service area. Extended routes are available across Central Florida for dedicated contracts. Contact us to discuss routes outside our standard coverage.
about.question2: What makes VitaLink different from standard couriers?
about.answer2: Our direct point-of-contact model sets us apart. When you call VitaLink, you speak directly with Ronald — not a call center. We specialize exclusively in medical logistics and maintain strict HIPAA, BBP, TWIC, and SAM.gov compliance. Every delivery is personally accountable, not just tracked by a system.

services.title: Services & Pricing
services.question1: How is pricing determined for STAT deliveries?
services.answer1: STAT deliveries start at $45 for a standard medical run within our base coverage area. Final pricing depends on mileage beyond the base zone, urgency level (STAT vs. standard), after-hours or weekend timing, and the type of cargo requiring special handling. Contact us for an immediate quote.
services.question2: Do you handle scheduled daily routes?
services.answer2: Yes. We offer scheduled route contracts for clinics, laboratories, and healthcare facilities that require daily or recurring pickups and deliveries. These arrangements come with priority dispatch, dedicated windows, and volume-based pricing. Reach out to discuss a custom schedule.

compliance.title: Compliance & Certification
compliance.answer1: Absolutely. All VitaLink couriers complete mandatory HIPAA training covering patient privacy, Protected Health Information (PHI) handling, and chain-of-custody protocols. Tamper-evident packaging and secure transport procedures are enforced on every run.
compliance.question2: What does TWIC certification mean for me?
compliance.answer2: TWIC (Transportation Worker Identification Credential) clearance means our couriers are background-checked and authorized by the TSA to access secure maritime facilities, ports, and restricted transportation zones. This is essential if your facility requires secure access for deliveries.

support.title: Support & Urgency
support.question1: What is the response time for a STAT request?
support.answer1: We commit to responding within minutes for STAT requests. Once confirmed, dispatch is initiated immediately. Our goal is to have a courier en route within 30 minutes for requests within our primary service area. For critical emergencies, contact us via WhatsApp or phone for the fastest response.
support.question2: How do I contact dispatch after hours?
support.answer2: VitaLink dispatch is available 24/7. You can reach us via WhatsApp at +1 (727) 947-2309 or by calling the same number directly. After-hours requests are handled with the same urgency and professionalism as standard business hours. We never leave a critical run unanswered.
